decisions.rationale: Leading Swampert and Goodra-Hisui counters opponent's hard Trick Room leads. Swampert provides Wide Guard to block Hyper Voice/Dazzling Gleam and Yawn to disrupt TR turns, while Goodra-Hisui pressures Gardevoir/Hatterene with Flash Cannon and Kingambit with Body Press. Garganacl in the back offers a second Wide Guard, Purifying Salt, and Salt Cure passive damage during TR. Charizard acts as a late-game fast win condition after TR expires.
decisions.notebook: Opponent hard TR composition: Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Hyper Voice/Helping Hand), Hatterene (Life Orb, Quiet: TR/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect), Kingambit (BlackGlasses, Brave, Supreme Overlord: Sucker Punch/Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Protect), Gardevoir-Mega (Modest: Hyper Voice/Psychic/TR/Protect). Unbrought G1: Arcanine-Hisui, Milotic. Strategic Fact: Farigiraf carries Mental Herb (immune to Taunt) and Armor Tail (blocks priority). Strategy: Avoid fast Sun early into hard TR; use Swampert + Goodra-Hisui + Garganacl bulk, Wide Guard, Yawn, and Salt Cure to ride out TR turns, then clean up with Charizard post-TR.

reflections.summary: Bringing Garganacl and Hisuian Goodra neutralized Kingambit early with Body Press, allowing Mega Charizard Y to safely evolve late and clean up remaining Trick Room setters under Sun.
reflections.adjustment: Be prepared for the opponent to bring Arcanine-Hisui or Milotic in Game 3 to counter sun and salt pressure, so avoid committing Charizard-Y prematurely if water/rock threats are brought.
reflections.notebook: Series tied 1-1. Revealed opponent sets: Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Hyper Voice, Psychic, Trick Room), Farigiraf (Quiet, Mental Herb, Armor Tail, Trick Room, Psychic), Kingambit (Brave, BlackGlasses, Supreme Overlord). Foe favors dual Trick Room setups. Garganacl's Body Press and Salt Cure combined with Charizard-Y Sun offense effectively dismantles their slow Trick Room core.

reflections.summary: The game was lost because Gardevoir-Mega entered at only 24% HP and was unable to sweep under Trick Room, while the opponent's Garganacl with Wide Guard and Salt Cure, along with Charizard-Y's Protect and Overheat, stalled out Trick Room turns and eliminated the weakened team. The player's spread moves were repeatedly blocked by Wide Guard, and they failed to remove Garganacl quickly enough.
reflections.adjustment: In the next game, prioritize eliminating Garganacl with single-target attacks to disable Wide Guard, and keep Gardevoir-Mega healthy. Consider leading with Kingambit and Farigiraf to pressure Garganacl early, or switch to a mode less reliant on spread moves that Wide Guard can block.
reflections.notebook: Opponent brought double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) to counter Trick Room spread. Garganacl lacks Protect, has Recover, Salt Cure, Body Press, SoftSand (no Ground move). Swampert has Yawn, Flip Turn, consumed Sitrus Berry. Goodra-H has Flash Cannon for Gardevoir. Charizard-Y is late-game cleaner with Overheat/Heat Wave/Solar Beam/Protect. Opponent's anti-TR strategy: stall with Wide Guard/Protect, then sweep with Charizard-Y. For game 3, consider anti-Wide Guard measures: single-target focus on Garganacl, preserve Gardevoir, or bring a different Mega/mode. Opponent may adapt by bringing Venusaur or Dragapult.
